summary.en: A widely spaced wordmark writes itself: every letter's outline starts on the same frame, grows as one continuous line and closes on the same frame, with a brief glow.
summary.zh: 大字距字标自己写出来：每个字的轮廓同一帧起笔、连续生长、同一帧收笔，收笔时轻轻一亮。

fits: A quiet wordmark or chapter title at the start or the end of a film: a name that should feel composed, not announced.
notFor: Body text or anything read for content; a busy ground behind the line; energetic openings (it is one slow breath).

overlaps.note: withholds meaning in discrete pieces; outline-write writes the whole word continuously
type laid along a path; outline-write draws the glyphs themselves

intent.en: Let a name feel composed rather than announced: one invisible hand writes every letter at once, so the word arrives as one calm act.
intent.zh: 让一个名字像被从容写成，而不是被喊出来：一只看不见的手同时写所有字，整个词作为一次安静的动作出现。

content.en: One wordmark or chapter title, a short word or name (en about 4–12 letters, zh 2–6 chars) set with wide tracking; optional solid fill at the close.
content.zh: 一个字标或章节标题，一个短词或名字（英文约 4–12 个字母，中文 2–6 字），大字距排；收笔时可选填实。

fits.zh: 片头或片尾安静的字标或章节标题：要显得从容写成、而不是被宣布出来的名字。

notFor.zh: 正文或任何要读内容的文字；线后面背景很花；有冲劲的开场（它是一次缓慢的呼吸）。

pairs.note: the written name settles into the brand lockup

en: Every letter must start and finish on the same frame; staggering them turns the ceremony into a typewriter.
The line must grow continuously; a mask uncovering it in pieces is seen through.
Keep the ground behind the line quiet; a 3 px line is lost over a busy picture.
zh: 所有字必须同帧起笔、同帧收笔；逐字错开就成了打字机。
笔画必须连续生长；用遮罩分段揭开会被看穿。
线背后的底要安静；3 px 的线在花的画面上会丢。

upstream.name: 字距结晶字标
upstream.summary: 大字距字标全字符并行连续描画结晶——所有字母同帧起笔、笔画像手写一样连续生长、同帧齐收成词；氛围底景上的品牌字标显影
upstream.use: 片尾/片头品牌字标登场（大字距细骨架字标；demo 为 video-shotcraft 全小写）；章节题字；needs 静谧/高级感的收束帧
upstream.energy: 低（静谧仪式感，一次呼吸完成）
